name: Spectrum Stress Storm
desc: A polariscope hurricane: dozens of colliding photoelastic stress fringes — real fringe-order physics, rainbow contours storming across dark glass.

name: Spectrum Fracture Polarized
desc: Cracked stressed glass: fringe rainbows CROWD at every crack tip (true stress concentration), the fractures glassy black.

name: Spectrum Tempered Ghost
desc: The polarized-sunglasses car-window secret: a drifting lattice of quench-spot stress rosettes in rose and iris over smoked glass.

name: Spectrum Abrasion Halo
desc: Scratch holography on polished steel: thousands of micro arcs whose spectral glints CRAWL along the scratches as the view tilts.

name: Spectrum Orbital Engrave
desc: Interlocking orbital ring systems cut into black chrome, each system flashing its glint at a different clock position — sequential fire.

name: Spectrum Swirl Supernova
desc: The detailer's swirl-mark nightmare made cosmic: micro arc-galaxies on deep violet, dispersive star glints riding every arc.

name: Spectrum Vinyl Groove
desc: Record grooves at hairline pitch sweeping in from off-canvas spindles, tone-arm rainbows raking across the tracks, anti-static dust glints.

name: Spectrum Data Etch
desc: Optical-disc data sectors: wedge fields of micro-tracks, every sector refracting its own order rainbow off the etched blocks.

name: Spectrum Grating Quilt
desc: Holo-foil patchwork: stitched tiles of hairline diffraction gratings at scattered angles — every patch fires its own color at its own angle.

name: Spectrum Liquid Crystal
desc: Cholesteric liquid crystal under the microscope: fingerprint pitch bands cycling the wheel, dark disclination defects threading through.

name: Spectrum Thermo Touch
desc: Thermochromic skin: heat blooms crawl through the LC spectrum (bronze-green-blue) over visible fingerprint texture — a touch-reactive heat map.

name: Spectrum Smectic Fan
desc: Smectic focal-conic fans: packed ribbed fan domains, each refracting its own slice of the wheel — polarized-microscope money shot.

name: Spectrum Black Opal
desc: Lightning Ridge black opal: sleeping color domains in near-black potch that DETONATE in spectral fire at the gate angle.

name: Spectrum Boulder Opal
desc: Boulder opal: rainbow fire running only in the veins through dark ironstone — the matrix stays stone, the seams burn.

name: Spectrum Opal Core
desc: Full crystal opal: wall-to-wall play-of-color domains over milk glass, every domain flashing on its own schedule.

name: Spectrum Contact Bloom
desc: Newton-ring blossoms: thin-film interference rings with true Airy crowding around every contact point, overlapping into gardens.

name: Spectrum Oilfilm Rain
desc: Gasoline rainbow after rain: drain-streaked oil film, rain-impact ring sets, wet aggregate poking through the slick.

name: Spectrum Prism Pool
desc: Dispersed caustics in a midnight pool: every dancing light filament is itself a tiny spectrum, red bending wider than blue.

name: Spectrum Jewel Box
desc: Stained-glass shard mosaic with dispersed caustics caged INSIDE each facet — light trapped in a jewel case.

name: Spectrum Moire Silk
desc: Two silk-fine line lattices a hair off angle: giant slow rainbow interference beats rolling over visible micro-threads.

name: Spectrum Interference Weave
desc: Over-under thread weave where the moire beat phase decides every crossing's hue — textile interference.

name: Spectrum Rainbow River
desc: Spectrum as a fluid: hue advected along real currents — rainbow streams, eddies trapping whirlpools of trapped color.

name: Spectrum Magnet Flow
desc: Iron filings in spectral ink: hue advected along true dipole field lines arcing pole to pole.

name: Spectrum Smoke Chroma
desc: Laminar smoke going turbulent, every filament carrying its slice of spectrum through the curl.

name: Spectrum Forge Heat
desc: True Planck incandescence: hammered steel glowing through cherry-orange-white by actual blackbody color, slag flecks quenching dark.

name: Spectrum Star Temperature
desc: The HR diagram as a sky: thousands of stars each colored by its real temperature class — red dwarfs to blue giants.

name: Spectrum Aberration Glitch
desc: A crisp mono mosaic shot through a broken lens: R and B sheared opposite ways so EVERY edge grows prism fringes.

name: Spectrum Ghost Prism
desc: Double-exposure spectroscopy: an attractor motif and its R/G/B ghosts offset in three directions — spectral echo art.

name: Spectrum Topo Rainbow
desc: Survey-fine elevation isolines cycling the wheel over shaded relief — cartography as iridescence.

name: Spectrum Pressure Map
desc: Meteorology in paint: cyclone isobar spirals cycling hue, wind-streak barbs combing between the cells.

name: Spectrum Lathe Burst
desc: Overlapping spin-cut systems; hue follows the cut angle like light raking spun metal — holographic engine-turning.

name: Spectrum Clockwork Dial
desc: Watch-dial guilloche: jittered gold rosettes over spectral lathe rings on near-black — horology under a prism.

name: Spectrum Redshift Drift
desc: Receding galaxies: streaks red-shifted trailing, blue-shifted leading, smeared along the expansion flow.

name: Spectrum Event Horizon
desc: An accretion disk doppler-beamed for real: the approaching side burns blue-white, the receding side dims red, around lensed black cores.

name: Spectrum Shatter Glass
desc: Tempered glass exploded: shard mosaic, each fragment refracting its own dispersion gradient, prism fringes at every fracture line.

name: Spectrum Diamond Fire
desc: Brilliant-cut scintillation: kite-facet fans with internal dispersion and white scintillation pins — ice with fire in it.

name: Spectrum Xray Bloom
desc: A garden in body color whose vein SKELETONS detonate spectral at the flash angle — the flowers x-ray themselves.

name: Spectrum Circuit Awakens
desc: Dormant circuitry: Manhattan traces and solder vias that power ON in spectral sequence as the view sweeps.

name: Spectrum Bismuth Garden
desc: Bismuth hopper crystals: stepped square-spiral terraces in anodize rainbow by depth — the staircase geode.

name: Spectrum Anodine Dunes
desc: Wind-rippled dunes anodized by slope aspect: straw-violet-cobalt riding the slip faces, grating-fine ripples everywhere.

name: Spectrum Peacock Eye
desc: Peacock train: dense structural-color eyespots (cobalt heart, teal iris, bronze halo) over fine radiating barbs.

name: Spectrum Beetle Elytra
desc: Jewel-scarab shell: hexagonal micro-dimple lattice with metallic green-gold bands sweeping across the carapace.

name: Spectrum Nacre Tide
desc: Abalone growth terraces: wavy stacked layer-lines, mother-of-pearl travel by layer count, dark conchiolin seams.

name: Spectrum Borealis Ice
desc: Aurora curtains REFRACTED through pack ice: every shard displaces and recolors the light passing through it.

name: Spectrum Spill Metropolis
desc: Gasoline rainbow on wet night asphalt: micro-aggregate, drain swirls, neon signs bleeding into the slick.

name: Spectrum Chromatic Orchid
desc: Orchid fields with spectral nectar-guide veins — the ultraviolet runway insects see, made visible.

name: Spectrum Mantis Strike
desc: Mantis-shrimp carapace: segmented armor plates each cycling its own spectral band, raptorial strike streaks in ember.

name: Spectrum Vhs Phantom
desc: Analog video breakdown: scanline micro, tracking-error rainbow tears, chromatic ghost offsets — the haunted tape.

name: Spectrum Flare Spectra
desc: Spectroheliograph corona: thin emission-line arcs in pure spectral colors leaping across near-black.

name: Spectrum Singularity Lens
desc: A deep-field sky gravitationally smeared into Einstein arcs and rings around invisible dark masses, violet rim-light on the voids.
